text:
## Your Complaint Rights Summary  
| Right | Details |
|---|---|
| **Free Complaint** | No charge to lodge or escalate |
| **8-Day Response** | We respond within 8 calendar days |
| **Full Investigation** | Thorough review of your issue |
| **Clear Explanation** | We explain our findings in detail |
| **Compensation** | If we're wrong, we compensate you |
| **Ombudsman Appeal** | Escalate to Financial Ombudsman if unhappy |
| **6-Month Window** | You have 6 months to escalate to Ombudsman |
| **No Retaliation** | We won't penalize you for complaining |

raw_entities.name: Complaint Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for handling customer complaints with mandatory response timelines, investigation requirements, and escalation rights to the Financial Ombudsman. The process includes free lodging, thorough investigation, detailed explanation of findings, and compensation where applicable.
context: No charge to lodge or escalate
Escalate to Financial Ombudsman if unhappy

raw_entities.name: Complaint Lodging
raw_entities.description: Initial step where customer submits a complaint without any charge or fee. This is the entry point to the complaint resolution process.
context: No charge to lodge or escalate

raw_entities.name: Complaint Investigation
raw_entities.description: Thorough review and investigation of the customer's complaint to establish facts and determine the bank's position on the matter.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Response
raw_entities.description: Bank provides a clear, detailed explanation of investigation findings to the customer within the mandated 8-day response window.
context: We explain our findings in detail

raw_entities.name: Compensation Decision
raw_entities.description: Determination of whether compensation is warranted based on investigation findings. Compensation is provided if the bank is found to be at fault.
context: If we're wrong, we compensate you

raw_entities.name: Ombudsman Escalation
raw_entities.description: Customer option to escalate unresolved or unsatisfactory complaint to the Financial Ombudsman within a 6-month window from the bank's response.
context: Escalate to Financial Ombudsman if unhappy

raw_entities.name: Bank Complaint Handler
raw_entities.description: Bank staff responsible for receiving, investigating, and responding to customer complaints within the defined process and timelines.
context: We explain our findings in detail
We won't penalize you for complaining

raw_entities.name: Financial Ombudsman
raw_entities.description: Independent external authority to which customers may escalate complaints if they are dissatisfied with the bank's response or investigation outcome.
context: Escalate to Financial Ombudsman if unhappy

raw_entities.name: Complaint Outcome Decision
raw_entities.decision_question: Is the bank at fault in the complaint?
raw_entities.path_yes: Compensation is provided to the customer
raw_entities.path_no: Complaint is rejected; customer may escalate to Ombudsman
raw_entities.description: Gate determining whether the bank's investigation concludes fault on the bank's part, triggering compensation obligation or complaint rejection.
context: If we're wrong, we compensate you

raw_entities.name: Ombudsman Escalation Eligibility
raw_entities.decision_question: Is the complaint escalation to Ombudsman within 6 months of bank response?
raw_entities.path_yes: Escalation to Financial Ombudsman is accepted
raw_entities.path_no: Escalation is time-barred and cannot proceed
raw_entities.description: Compliance gate verifying that customer escalation to the Financial Ombudsman occurs within the 6-month window from the bank's response date.
context: You have 6 months to escalate to Ombudsman

raw_entities.name: Complaint Response Timeline Compliance
raw_entities.regulatory_basis: Banking conduct and complaint handling regulations
raw_entities.evidence_required: Documented response to customer within 8 calendar days
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate ensuring the bank responds to all complaints within 8 calendar days. Failure to meet this timeline constitutes a regulatory breach.

raw_entities.name: Ombudsman Escalation Rights Compliance
raw_entities.regulatory_basis: Financial Ombudsman Service rules and consumer protection regulations
raw_entities.evidence_required: Clear communication of Ombudsman escalation rights and 6-month window to customer
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate ensuring customers are informed of their right to escalate to the Financial Ombudsman and the 6-month escalation window.
context: You have 6 months to escalate to Ombudsman

raw_entities.name: Non-Retaliation Compliance
raw_entities.regulatory_basis: Consumer protection and fair treatment regulations
raw_entities.evidence_required: Documented policy and training ensuring no adverse action against complaining customers
raw_entities.description: Mandatory compliance gate ensuring the bank does not penalize or retaliate against customers for lodging or escalating complaints.
context: We won't penalize you for complaining

raw_entities.name: Complaining Customer
raw_entities.description: A customer who has lodged a complaint with the bank regarding a service issue or dispute. The customer has defined rights including free complaint lodging, investigation, response, and escalation to the Financial Ombudsman.
context: No charge to lodge or escalate
You have 6 months to escalate to Ombudsman
We won't penalize you for complaining
